preconditions.description: The number of water tanks n is between 2 and 50 inclusive.
The total increase in pipe width k is between 0 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= c[i][j] <= 10**6 for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each pipe width c[i][j] is between 0 and 10^6 inclusive.
There are no pipes from a tank to itself, i.e., c[i][i] is 0 for all i.

postconditions.description: The output is the maximum amount of water that can be transmitted from the main tank (1) to the sewer tank (n) per unit of time after increasing the width of some subset of pipes by at most k units in total.
